suite: AUTH02 local synthetic contract tests; no live account or API calls

results.name: canonical active and authorized profiles pass without invented roles
empty or conflicting canonical projections stay closed
unverified, preview, blocked and incomplete identities stay closed
expired/future/malformed entitlement bounds stay closed
selected actor and per-entitlement permissions must agree
legitimate dual-profile actor retains independent grants and canonical active selection
safe continuation rejects open redirects, controls, role switches and nested URLs
real password contract uses only email/password then strict resolve
invalid password never stores credential or calls preview challenge
old account is revoked before a new password attempt and cannot rehydrate on failure
failed old-account revocation preserves retry credential and prevents new password exchange
credential storage failure revokes the issued credential using its explicit headers
malformed credential or ambiguous response cannot authenticate
incomplete profile revokes newly issued session before clearing locally
acknowledged server logout clears bridge, selection and all private caches
ambiguous logout keeps credentials for retry but closes cache and reload bootstrap
post-password revocation failure remains closed and retryable
logout serializes pending password exchange and prevents late session hydration
old bootstrap response cannot reopen a logged-out UI
public host never posts password or attempts resident resolution
